paite: Huan mun siangthou kongpi ponungzaw, suahlam nga ah hon pikik nawn a, kong khaksa ana hi.
heading: Suahlam Kongpi Kizatna

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai kongpi akikhak gige ding a, akihong ngei kei ding a, kuamah alut sam kei ding uh; TOUPA, Israel' Pathian ahong lut khit ziak in; akikhak gige ding ahi.
Kumpi bel TOUPA ma a an ne ding in huai ah atu phet ding; sumtawng kongkhak ah alut ding a, huai mah ah apawt nawn ding," achi hi.
Huan mallam nga kongpi ah tempul intual ah ahon pi a; ka en a ngai dih, TOUPA thupina in TOUPA tempul aluahdim vek a; huchi in bokkhup in ka pukta hi.
heading: Tempul Lut Phalna Dante

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, TOUPA tempul zatdan leh adan tengteng na kiang a ka gen tungtang ah na bildoh inla, na mitsuan inla, na lungsim ah chiamteh hoih dih; atempul a lutdante, amun siangthou a kipan pawtdante, na lungsim ah hoihtak in chiamteh in.
"Huan helhat, Israel inkote ngei kiang ah huchi in na gen ding ahi; Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, nou Israel inkote aw, na thilhih kihhuai tengteng uh ahunta,
lungtang leh sa zeksum louh, ka tanghoute, thaute na lat lai ua ka mun siangthou, ka tempul mahmah hihbuah ding a na pilut ua, ka thukhun a na tatlek uh, na kihhuaina tengtengte uh na tawpta hen.
Ka thil siangthoute nou na kem kei ua, hiai pau tuam mite ka mun siangthou ah nou sik a kemmi in na sep zaw uhi."
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamdangmi kuamah, lungtang leh sa zeksum louh, Israel suante lak a gamdangmi kuamah ka mun siangthou ah alut ding uh ahi kei hi.”
Levi chi, Israelte milim delh a avakmang lai ua kei a kipan a gamlapi a paisate'n bel athulimlouhna uh apo ding uh.
heading: Siamputna Ah Levite Posiah Ahi Uh

paite: Ka mun siangthou ah nasemmi in apang ding ua; tempul kongkhakte angak ding ua; tempul sung ah nna asem ding uh; halmang kithoihnate, mipi a dia kithoihnate agou ding ua; mipi nna sepsak ding in ama uah adingh ding uhi.

Amilimte uh ma ah a-nna uh asepsak ding ua; Israelte inkote a ding in thulimlouhna a pukna ahih nak ziak un atung uah ka khut ka lik ding a; athulimlouhna uh apo ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.

Huchi in ka kiang ah siampu nna sem ding in ahon naih ngei kei ding ua; ka thil siangthoute, thil siangthoupente ahon naih ngei sam kei ding uh; azahlakna uleh athilkihhuai hihsate uh apo zaw ding uh.
Tempul kem mite ding in ka bawl ding a, nasepna tengteng leh hih ding om peuhmahte hih ding in.

Siampu Levi chi, Zadok ta, kei a kipan a Israel suante avakmang lai ua ka mun siangthou kem mite'n bel ka nna sem ding in ahong naih ding uh; thau leh sisan lan ding in ka ma ah adingh ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
heading: Siampute

paite: Ka mun siangthou ah alut ding ua, nna hon sepsak ding in ka dohkan ahong naih ding ua, kei hon kemmi in apang ding uh.
Huan huang sungnungzaw kongpite a alut un puanaktual malngat in akithuam ding ua, huang sungnungzaw leh insung lam a nna asep sung un samul puan asilh ding uh ahi kei hi.
Dial malngat akhim ding ua, puanmalngat pheitom abun ding ua, kho-ulsak thei asilh ding uh ahi kei hi.

Huan huangsung ponungzaw, vantang kiang a ahong pawtkhiak uleh anasepna puansilhte uh asuah ding ua, dantan siangthou ah akoih ding uh, puansilh dang asilh ding uh; mipite apuansilh ua misiangthou a abawl teilouhna ding un.
Alute uh ametgiau ding uh ahi kei a; asam uh leng ahawisau ding uh ahi sam kei; amet lel ding uh ahi.
Siampu kuapeuh huang sungnungzaw pen alut chiang un uain adawn ding uh ahi kei hi.
Meithai hiam maksa nung hiam zi in anei ding uh ahi sam kei hi; Israel inkote, nungak siangthou hiam siampu sihsan meithai akitenpih zawk ding uh ahi.
Ka mite thil siangthou leh thil nin kibatlouhdan ahilh ding ua; siang leh siang lou akhentuamsak ding uhi.

Thubuaite leng angaihtuah ding uh ahi; ka ngaihtuah bang zel in angaihtuah ding uh; ka ankuanglui sehsa tengteng ah ka dante leh ka dan thuseh bawlsate azuih ding uh ahi; ka Sabbathte leng atan ding uh ahi.
Amau kihihbuah ding in misi luang anaih ding uh ahi kei; himahleh nu hiam, pa hiam, tanu hiam, tapa hiam unaupa hiam sanggamnu pasal nei lou hiam a ding in bel akihihbuah thei ding uh.
Huan akisiansak nung in amah a ding in ni sagih simsak nawn ding ahi.
Huang sungnungzaw mun siangthou a nasem ding a alut ni in khelh ziak a kithoihna amah a ding in alan ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Goutan bangmah anei kei ding ua; agoutan uh kei ka hi ding. Israel ah tan bangmah na pe ding uh ahi kei, atan uh keimah ka hi.
Nek ding latte, khelh ziak a thillatte, moh ziak a thillatte ane ding ua; Israel lak a thil latsa peuhmah amau a ding ahi.

Gah masate lak a ahoihpente, na thillat chiteng ua ahoihpen, na thillat tengteng ua siampute a ding ahi; na inn ua vualzawlna atamdet theihna ding in tangbuang meklom hoihpen siampu kiang ah na pe ding uh ahi.
Siampute'n sapul anek louh ding uh ahi. Vasa hiam gamsa bohzan hiam, amah sih a si hiam anek ding uh ahi kei hi.
